note: Canonical colour tokens. docs/CREATIVE_STYLE_BIBLE.md explains the use; this file is the only place hex values live.

answer_coral.role: the answer / key object (one per shot)

true_green.role: myth check: supported (always with a check icon)

false_red.role: myth check: not supported (always with a cross icon)

chroma_key.role: flat background of the expression sheets (VB-09); keyed out, never on screen

large_text_only.note: 3.96:1 - use only for text of 24 px bold or larger; small red labels sit on a paper chip next to a red icon

fill_only_rule: Accent colours are 1.5-3.7:1 against paper, below the 3:1 that graphics need. They are fills; every shape that carries meaning also has an ink stroke (>= 4 px at 1080p), and meaning is never carried by colour alone.
